system.description:
(Smash)

With a Heavy melee weapon held in two hands, you may make an attack with Disadvantage. If it hits, roll one extra weapon damage die (two from 10th level).

Available to: Fighters, Barbarians, Knights, Paladins, Spellblades, Bards, Rangers, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, Rogues, Assassins, and Monks.

rules.value: Power Attack: on a hit add one extra weapon damage die (two from 10th level).
